about_the_game:
Test your karting skills in a Career Mode where you'll manage your racing career through several different types of racing events.  Battle to win races,  handle media interviews,  and customize your go-kart paint livery to your desired style as you try to become the best go kart driver in the world.

FEATURES & MODES

  • Career Mode 

  • Online Trials

  • Go-Kart Livery Editor

  • Steam Achievements

  • New HD Go-Kart Race Tracks

  • Dirt Track Racing

CAREER MODE

  • Progress through an in-depth Career Mode as your develop your skills. 

  • Speak with media reporters to handle your public reputation. 

  • Level up through the ranks as you earn achievements and improve your standing on the leaderboard.

QUICK RACES

  • Customize the length of your own races on several different racetracks.

  • Compete in quick races to practice and improve your speed.

COMPETITIVE RACING

  • Intense multi-groove racing that features real-time pathfinding and maneuverability from every driver.  

  • Drivers can react to your driving style on the fly and make real-time decisions.

  • Varying levels of difficulty from each driver as they each have their own unique traits and driving skills

     

HIGH DEFINITION GRAPHICS

  • Major improvements and upgrades to the high-definition rendering capabilities. 

  • Custom & Animated Driver IK that Improves Every Animation

  • DirectX 12 Support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7+
  • Processor: Intel i3 Processor or Higher
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1000 Series or Higher
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Gamepads Supported for Driving Controls
